items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Sidney deParis was his trumpet. He was with Don. He had a bunch of fellows who I didn't know.

ctx.x: No. Let me see, what is the bass player's name? I forget now. No, the one I'm thinking about, the ...(?)., his name is John, a big yellow... He looked like Lester Young. Big-eyed yellow boy. Yeah, he was with Snub. Sidney deParis was his trumpet. He was with Don. He had a bunch of fellows who I didn't know. And some of the boys was from Panama. The baritone player, he and I roomed mostly together all the time.
